name: 25 Pcs Magnetic Building Blocks Set | STEM Educational Rods & Balls Toy for Kids
description:
Spark your child’s creativity and learning with this 25 Pcs Magnetic Building Blocks Toy Set. Designed for fun and educational play, it includes colorful magnetic rods and metal balls that can be assembled into endless 3D shapes. This interactive toy stimulates imagination, problem-solving, hand-eye coordination, sensory skills, and intellectual growth while promoting parent-child bonding. Suitable for kids under 14 years, it’s perfect for early STEM learning and encourages logical thinking, color recognition, and emotional development. Durable and child-safe, it provides hours of safe, engaging, and creative play.
Key Features
 25-piece magnetic set with rods and metal balls
 Enhances hand-eye coordination, sensory, and problem-solving skills
 Stimulates creativity, logical thinking, and color recognition
 Durable, child-safe plastic and strong magnets
 Suitable for kids under 14 years for educational play
How to Use
 Connect magnetic rods and balls to form shapes and structures
 Experiment with 2D and 3D designs for creative learning
 Use daily to enhance STEM skills and imagination
 Encourage group play for teamwork and parent-child interaction
Material
Durable, non-toxic plastic and strong magnets
Safety Information
 Not suitable for children under 3 years
 Keep small parts away from young children to avoid choking
 Supervise children during play
Package Includes
 25 × Magnetic rods and metal balls building set
